findings.description: Every TSK_ in sop_modules.json has a matching rate in production.json, and vice versa. Zero orphans in either direction.
findings.details: 69 tasks in SOP, 69 tasks in production. Perfect 1:1 mapping confirmed.

findings.rule: RULE 8 — UOM matching between sop_modules and production
findings.description: All 69 tasks have identical unit_of_measure in both sop_modules.json and production.json.
findings.details: Dual UOM system (EA for risers/balusters/newels, LF for stringers/handrails/base rails, FIXED for system-level tasks, SF for floor protection) is consistent across files.

findings.description: All 69 tasks have identical task_classification (binary or qt_scaled) in both sop_modules.json and production.json.

findings.rule: Rate sanity — no rate exceeds 2000 SF/hr or equivalent
findings.description: Maximum rate is 350 LF/hr (TSK_STRP_SPRAY_FINISH_STRINGER). No rates exceed the 2000 threshold.
findings.details: All rates are within expected ranges. Spray rates are higher than brush rates as expected. FIXED time tasks range from 3 to 90 minutes.

findings.description: All 4 assessment tasks (TSK_STRP_ASSESS_CONDITION, TSK_STRP_ASSESS_ADHESION, TSK_STRP_ASSESS_COATING_ID, TSK_STRP_ASSESS_ANTISLIP) use FIXED unit_of_measure with appropriate fixed_time_minutes or fixed_time_minutes_by_tier.
findings.details: TSK_STRP_ASSESS_CONDITION is qt_scaled with FIXED UOM (8/12/18 min by tier). Other 3 are binary FIXED.

findings.description: quality_tier_effects.values confirms QT3=1.0, QT4=1.3, QT5=1.5 — standard global values with no surface-specific overrides.
findings.details: Stairs use global QT modifiers per Stairway_Systems_Doctrine Section 10.1.

findings.description: FAC_BALUSTER_PROFILE (square=1.0x, turned=1.75x) is correctly applied to baluster-specific tasks only: TSK_STRP_DEGLOSS_BALUSTER, TSK_STRP_SCRAPE_FEATHER_RAILING, TSK_STRP_PRIME_BALUSTER, TSK_STRP_BRUSH_FINISH_BALUSTER. Not applied to TSK_STRP_SPRAY_FINISH_BALUSTER — correct, because spray rates are profile-independent (rate_basis_notes confirms: 'All profiles spray at similar rates').
findings.details: Modifier correctly absent from newel, handrail, base rail, riser, and stringer tasks.

findings.description: All convention rules verified: task_classification (not task_class), CON_ prefix (not CONS_), severity values (critical/major/minor), phase values (setup/prep/prime/interstage/finish/cleanup), units uppercase (EA, LF, SF, FIXED), skill_level (helper/journeyman/lead).
findings.details: No convention violations found in sop_modules.json or production.json.

findings.rule: RULE 6 — Zone IDs match between research and sop_modules
findings.description: 5 protection zones in research.json protection_zones_analysis match 5 zones in sop_modules.json protection_metadata: stair_tread_covers, floor_perimeter, wall_adjacent, spray_containment, carpet_runner_protection.
findings.details: Each zone has matching setup_task and teardown_task. stair_tread_covers also has maintenance_task (TSK_STRP_TREAD_PROTECT_VERIFY).

findings.rule: RULE 11 — Only enum values from resolution.json applicable_enums
findings.description: All enum values used in sop_modules.json and production.json are within the applicable_enums defined in resolution.json.
findings.details: quality_tier: QT3/QT4/QT5 (valid). application_method: brush/spray (valid). sheen: satin/semi-gloss/gloss (valid). phase: setup/prep/prime/interstage/finish/cleanup (valid). task_classification: binary/qt_scaled (valid). skill_level: helper/journeyman/lead (valid). unit_of_measure: EA/LF/SF/FIXED (valid). substrate_state: all SS_INT_* values (valid). condition_scale: GOOD/FAIR/POOR (valid).

findings.description: Canonical painting sequence (stringers -> risers -> balusters -> newels -> handrails -> base rails) is correctly enforced in MOD_STRP_PREP (degloss tasks), MOD_STRP_PRIME (prime tasks), and MOD_STRP_FINISH (brush and spray finish tasks).
findings.details: Sequence enforcement is documented in canonical_sequence_enforcement block and sequence_notes for each affected module.

findings.rule: Tread protection is first setup task
findings.description: TSK_STRP_TREAD_PROTECT is the first task in MOD_STRP_SETUP, marked as mandatory at all tiers with condition 'always'. Task description explicitly states 'FIRST task — before any other work'.
findings.details: Tread protection removal (TSK_STRP_REMOVE_TREAD_PROTECT) is correctly the last teardown task in cleanup.

findings.description: MOD_STRP_PRIME correctly uses state-driven primer selection with substrate_state_rules. All prime tasks apply when SS_INT_FAILING_PAINT/PEELING/MOISTURE_DAMAGE/SMOKE_DAMAGE and skip when SS_INT_SOUND_PAINT.
findings.details: 7 material systems confirmed: 3 state-driven primers (adhesion, stain-block, mildew-resistant), 3 QT-driven finish (standard acrylic, modified urethane, premium), 1 optional poly topcoat.

findings.description: task_count_summary.total in sop_modules.json was 68 but actual task count is 69 (7+4+5+14+8+7+12+12 = 69). Off by 1.
findings.fix_applied: Corrected total from 68 to 69 and total_excluding_shared_rrp from 63 to 64 in sop_modules.json. Updated corresponding note in production.json estimation_notes.task_count_verification.

stair_specific_checks.canonical_sequence: PASS — stringers -> risers -> balusters -> newels -> handrails -> base rails enforced in prep, prime, and finish modules
stair_specific_checks.tread_protection_first: PASS — TSK_STRP_TREAD_PROTECT is first setup task, mandatory at all tiers
stair_specific_checks.state_driven_primer: PASS — all prime tasks use substrate_state_rules with SS_INT_* states, not substrate-driven NC patterns
stair_specific_checks.condition_modifiers_prep_only: PASS — FAC_CONDITION_SCALE appears only in prep-phase tasks (degloss, scrape/feather, caulk assess, spot prime, dust clean). Never in finish-phase tasks.
stair_specific_checks.baluster_profile_modifier: PASS — FAC_BALUSTER_PROFILE applied to baluster-specific tasks only (degloss, scrape/feather railing, prime, brush finish). Correctly absent from spray finish (profile-independent).
stair_specific_checks.stringer_type_modifier: PASS — FAC_STRINGER_TYPE applied to stringer-specific tasks only (degloss, scrape/feather riser/stringer, prime, brush/spray finish stringer).
stair_specific_checks.stairwell_access_modifier: PASS — FAC_STAIRWELL_ACCESS applied to stringer tasks only. Other components accessed from adjacent treads (H1_STANDARD).

modifier_stacking_review.coating_pool_max_realistic: QT5(1.50) x turned_baluster(1.75) = 2.63x for baluster coating; QT5(1.50) x open_stringer(1.40) x step_ladder(1.30) = 2.73x for stringer coating
